strings.行=集合 列=元素，亮行=被选中的集合: Rows = sets, columns = elements, lit row = chosen set
strings.解移向平坦高原: The solution drifts onto a flat plateau
strings.访问优先序（放得下才去）: Visiting priority order (only go if it fits)
strings.课表：列 = 星期，行 = 节次，每格最多 {n} 块（{n} 间教室）；颜色: Timetable: columns = weekdays, rows = periods, at most {n} blocks per cell ({n} rooms); colour = course; the scheduling order is what is searched, and the decoder takes the earliest legal slot for each lecture
strings.赛程×地理：上半=球队主城点图（位置即实例，两两距离取整欧氏），下半=轮次表（左: Schedule × geography: top = map of the teams' home cities (position is the instance, pairwise distances are rounded Euclidean), bottom = round table (left solid = home team, right outline = away team, red frame = repeat of the previous round's pairing). Objective: total travel distance (raw) + pairing completeness (dominant ×{n}) + home/away streaks > {n} (×{n}) + repeat pairings (×{n})
strings.轮次表：每行=一轮，块=队号（左实块=主队 右描边=客队，金圈=焦点队）。目标全: Round table: each row = one round, block = team number (left solid = home team, right outline = away team, gold ring = focus team). All objectives are soft: home/away balance / streaks / pairing completeness (dominant) / spread of focus matches
strings.近似 随机赋值即 1/2；Yannakakis 改进: Approximation A random assignment already gives 1/2; Yannakakis improved it
strings.连续域原生：PSO/DE/CMA-ES 等实数编码算法在 BBOB 函数跑分；曲: Native continuous domain: real-encoded algorithms such as PSO / DE / CMA-ES scored on BBOB functions; curve = best-so-far convergence. Note: the f numbering is this site's teaching order — f1 sphere / f2 ellipsoid agree with official COCO, while f3–f6 (cigar / discus / different powers / sharp ridge) are real functions of the BBOB suite but not the official COCO numbers (official f3–f6 = separable Rastrigin / Büche-Rastrigin / Linear Slope / Attractive Sector)
strings.选 IBEA：加性 ε 指标直接当适应度，不做支配排序；对照 NSGA-II 看: Choose IBEA: the additive ε-indicator is used directly as fitness, with no dominance sorting; compare with NSGA-II on concave fronts such as ZDT2
strings.选 MOEA/D：每个权重向量对应一个 Tchebycheff 子问题；对照 N: Choose MOEA/D: every weight vector corresponds to a Tchebycheff subproblem; compare with NSGA-II on the spread over three-objective fronts and on DTLZ1 convergence
strings.选 R-NSGA-II：黑色菱形 = 决策者给的参考点，种群只铺在它附近那一段前: Choose R-NSGA-II: the black diamond = the reference point given by the decision maker, and the population only spreads over the part of the front near it (so a large IGD is expected); compare with NSGA-II, which covers the whole front
